subject: english
stem:
The class asked students what games they wanted, tested two ideas, and changed the rules after feedback. The final activity worked well for more students.
Which summary keeps the right focus?
options: Every game needs the same rules
Students were not allowed to speak
Student feedback helped improve the class activity

optionRationales.reason: The class tested two ideas：只抓到流程中一步。
Every game needs the same rules：原文明說依 feedback 改規則。
Students were not allowed to speak：第一句正是詢問學生。
Student feedback helped improve the class activity：詢問、測試與修改都圍繞回饋改善活動。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「多句以重複、同義或因果方式回到的共同概念」可推出 Student feedback helped improve the class activity；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 Student feedback helped improve the class activity 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
